exposure: PPP with placental accreta vs. PPP without placental accreta
cohort: 148 pregnant women with PPP (62 with placental accreta and 86 without) and 74 pregnant women without PPP who underwent cesarean section
finding: ADAM17 expression was higher in patients with PPP, and it was associated with gravidity, history of cesarean delivery, and history of abortions.
mod_finding: The study included pregnant women without pernicious placenta previa (PPP) who had undergone cesarean section as controls.
